_doc: Selectable worlds. Each is a complete, independent dataset — its own criteria, archetypes, universes and destinations — scored by the exact same engine. `standInPhotos` marks a world whose photographs are stand-ins for somewhere that does not exist, so their real subjects are named only in the credits.
